questions.title: Top K Frequent Values
questions.prompt: Return the k most frequent integers in nums. If two values have the same frequency, the smaller value comes first.
questions.hint: Count with a dictionary or Counter, then order by frequency descending and value ascending.
questions.solution:
def top_k_frequent(nums, k):
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(nums)
    ordered = sorted(counts, key=lambda x: (-counts[x], x))
    return ordered[:k]

questions.title: Task Conflict Pairs
questions.prompt: Given task intervals [start, end], count pairs of tasks whose time ranges overlap. Intervals that only touch at an endpoint do not overlap.
questions.hint: Sort by start time. For each interval, later intervals cannot overlap once their start is at least the current end.

questions.title: Battery Job Scheduler
questions.prompt: Each job is [duration, battery_cost]. You have a fixed battery budget. Jobs may be completed in any order and only battery_cost reduces the budget. Return the maximum number of jobs you can finish.
questions.hint: To maximize how many jobs fit in the budget, choose lower battery costs first.

questions.title: Group Anagram Sizes
questions.prompt: Group words that are anagrams of one another and return only the group sizes, sorted from largest to smallest.
questions.hint: A sorted word can be used as a dictionary key for its anagram group.

questions.title: Fixed Window Maximum Sum
questions.prompt: Return the largest sum of any contiguous subarray of exactly k elements. Return None when k is invalid for nums.
questions.hint: Compute the first window once, then subtract the outgoing value and add the incoming value.
